item.title: WLS 2026 Opens in Dubai with Mobius Forum on Day One, Co-Hosted by KuCoin
item.description: PROVIDENCIALES, Turks and Caicos Islands, Feb. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — The World Laureates Summit 2026 (WLS 2026) officially opened today in Dubai. item.title: MAIPs donates RM150,000 to help flood victims in Aceh
item.description: KANGAR: The Perlis Islamic Religious and Malay Customs Council (MAIPs) has expressed its high commitment to the universal humanitarian agenda by channeling a donation of RM150,000 to alleviate the suffering of flood victims in Aceh, Indonesia. item.title: Carlo Rino proposes move to Main Market by second half of 2026
